hooks.text: 单人或组队参加全球街球淘汰赛，在威尼斯海滩等传奇球场连胜晋级
hooks.excerpt: Play Solos or Squads, the choice is yours. Face off against the best of the best in online multiplayer Knockout Tournaments spanning the globe on legendary streetball courts from Venice Beach, to The Tenement in the Philippines, and more. Lock in, win, advance, repeat.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 回滚网络让摇杆输入即时同步，可连续完成晃倒、防守封盖和转身空接绝杀
hooks.excerpt: Powered by true rollback netcode, your moves on the sticks will sync instantaneously – cross up an aggressive defender, pull down a towering block, or throw up a lob out of a spin move for a game winning alley-oop.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 防守与进攻同等有力，封盖、扑救地板球和抢断都能直接转化为胜势
hooks.excerpt: It’s not only about the high flying dunks, stepback logo 3s and ankle breakers – in NBA THE RUN, defense is just as fun, and powerful, as offense. Thunderous blocks, diving for loose balls, huge steals, and all-out physicality on D can lead to a W and will get you just as hyped.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
